scope: Deployed caller provenance source, configuration and preservation inspection

source_findings.hospital_replay_post: edge/capture_api/cloud_client.py send_to_cloud attaches traffic_headers('replay') before POST
source_findings.hospital_reconciliation_get_gap: edge/capture_api/cloud_client.py get_cloud_event_status performs GET without traffic_headers and is unclassified
source_findings.dashboard_live_post: dashboard/main.py forward_request attaches traffic_headers('live') only to POST /events
source_findings.external_caller_gap: Direct Cloud callers must explicitly attach a live credential. Several infrastructure verification scripts issue direct /events calls without telemetry provenance; these are test tools, and no general external production workload instrumentation was found.

deployment_decision.dashboard: No deployment is required while direct Cloud submission remains disabled. Its deployed live credential/helper is valid, but the guarded route does not emit application traffic.
deployment_decision.hospitals: A code update and controlled Hospital A/B deployment are required to mark reconciliation GETs as replay traffic if full Hospital provenance coverage is required.
deployment_decision.external_workloads: Each real external live workload producer requires a live telemetry credential/header integration and separate deployment or ingress instrumentation.
